Of 49 older shortlisted/kept 6+ ads reopened, 19 are closed (including NotarPartner, JUPUS x2, eventfirst, CEEZER, Grafana) and 12 are confirmed live; profile.md changed only by a source note since the last sweep, so yesterday's shortlist was not re-judged. open_questions: The sandbox refused a curl with a spoofed browser User-Agent on 2026-10-29, so http link checks ran with curl's default User-Agent (they worked for Personio, join.com, Arbeitnow, 9am.works and freelancermap). Should the agent definition's browser-UA http check stay, or should it say "curl default UA"?

Clera (getclera.com) is an AI recruiting marketplace whose Ashby board lists about 300 roles for unnamed clients, many fullstack and AI roles in Munich and Berlin. Treat them as recruiter ads (company 0, kept at best) as done here, or leave Clera out of the search?
